x: Alan Picton, making a reappearance, won the 220 yds. with Cornish second and Bob Wolton third. In the 440 yds. we saw Dicky Bartlett beat Bob Taylor, with Jim Heathfield in third place.
Powell-Jones who set up a new Surrey County record in the shot put with a put of 48' 10". Despite a recent injury, Alan Sexton won the 440yds in 49.4secs. with A.

Alan Picton made a welcome return to the track and was well pleased to finish 3rd in the 440 yards final in 50.3s. George Davidson although faced with tough opposition, ran well to finish 6th in the half mile, whilst Peter Bagnall lacking the necessary fast finish, recorded 4th in the mile in 4m.20s.
